Autotrader pages that print \\u0027Dealer Fees Included\\u0027 or \\u0027No Additional Dealer Fees\\u0027 are all-in; a page that itemizes fee lines with amounts (Autotrader: Dealer Fee, Electronic Filing Fee, Private Tag Agency Fee, Pre-Delivery Service Fee; cars.com: Electronic Filing Fee and any sibling fee line with an amount) is itemized with the sum as the total; anything else is unknown; carvana postings stay null; proven by tests over fixtures cut from the 2026-09-26 recorded pages covering each case on each site\u0022,\u0022VehiclePricing\\u0027s purchase price becomes asking plus shipping fee plus itemized fees total when known (an all-in or unknown posture adds nothing), used by budget, rank, and show exactly as the shipping fee is today; odo show prints the fee posture and the itemized total under the price, and rank --detail names the fees in its breakdown; proven by tests\u0022,\u0022A new red flag kind, add-ons-dealer, fires for a vehicle whose cheapest active posting has an unknown fee posture at a dealer whose AddOnsNote says the dealer sells add-ons (CarEdge\\u0027s wording, read from the stored note), with a detail naming the dealer and its doc fee when known; an itemized or all-in posting never fires it; the flag appears in show, research, and rank like the others; docs/research.md\\u0027s red-flag table gains its row and docs/walk.md says how fee statements are read; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Second task from the discovery walk of idea adf5634b, stop 1 (ideas/adf5634b-site-specific-logic-for-each-walk-site-use-each-site-s-own-f/workspace/journal.md). Brian\\u0027s concern, in his words: dealers list a price \\u0027as almost a bait and switch ... they\\u0027re going to tack on a bunch of fees when you show up\\u0027, mostly on cars.com and Autotrader; Carvana does not do that. His rulings: fees are an input to rank plus a flag, never a filter; an itemized total is trusted as the page\\u0027s fees and the CarEdge add-ons flag is carried alongside it; a posting with unknown posture at an add-ons dealer gets a red flag. Evidence from the 2026-09-26 walk recordings under ~/Library/Application Support/Odonomics/walks/: cars.com 23 of 84 detail pages print \\u0027Seller has no extra fees\\u0027 and \\u0027The price shown here is the all-in total\\u0027, 27 print \\u0027Electronic Filing Fee\\u0027, the rest only the generic taxes and registration disclaimer; Autotrader prints \\u0027Dealer Fees Included\\u0027 on 58 pages, \\u0027No Additional Dealer Fees\\u0027 on 12, and itemizes Dealer Fee, Electronic Filing Fee, Private Tag Agency Fee, and Pre-Delivery Service Fee with amounts on a handful (earlier verified example: Electronic Filing Fee 529, Private Tag Agency Fee 179, Reconditioning Fee 987). Code: the walk\\u0027s detail-page path in src/Odonomics/Cli/Commands/WalkCommand.cs has the body text at the point it builds the ListingCandidate (the carvana shipping-fee extraction from PR #45 is the precedent for a deterministic page-text reader feeding a candidate field); ListingCandidate.cs and LedgerUpsertService.UpsertAsync carry it to the posting; src/Odonomics/Ledger/VehiclePricing.cs (LowestCurrentPurchasePrice, PurchasePrice record) is the single place price becomes a purchase figure; red flags are evaluated in src/Odonomics/Domain/RedFlagsEvaluator.cs (kinds such as mileage-drop and price-spike) and summarized by src/Odonomics/Cli/ResearchSummaryLine.cs; the dealer\\u0027s DocFee and AddOnsNote columns come from c7313844. walk records each site\\u0027s own deal badges and the cars.com dealer rating from the result cards as posting attributes, and show and rank display them without letting them touch the score, so the sites\\u0027 price opinions are visible beside odo\\u0027s own ranking\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022From the card text the walk already collects (PR #51), a per-site badge reader records posting attributes: cars.com deal (Great Deal, Good Deal), demand (High Demand), and dealer-rating (the numeric rating on the card, for example 4.9); Autotrader deal (Great Price, Good Price), price-drop (Price Drop), and paperwork (Online Paperwork); carvana deal (Great Deal), price-drop (Price Drop), and shipping (Free shipping); a card with no badge records nothing; a known posting touched from its card gets its attributes refreshed the same way; proven by tests over card texts cut from the 2026-09-26 recorded search pages for all three sites\u0022,\u0022odo show lists the attributes under the posting (already printed generically by c7313844) and rank gains one short column, Site, showing the deal badge abbreviated (GD, GrD, GP, GrP) and a dealer rating when present, fitting the existing 80-column layout without wrapping; the ranking order and every cost figure are unchanged, proven by a test that ranks a fixture ledger with and without badges and asserts identical order\u0022,\u0022docs/walk.md says which badges each site prints and that they are recorded as attributes, and docs/cost-model.md says badges never influence the score and why (a site\\u0027s price opinion is untested until ledger history shows whether badged cars sell faster or drop less); dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Third task from the discovery walk of idea adf5634b, stop 3 (ideas/adf5634b-site-specific-logic-for-each-walk-site-use-each-site-s-own-f/workspace/journal.md). Brian\\u0027s ruling: capture and display the badges and the dealer rating, never score on them; revisit only after months of ledger history. Counts from the 2026-09-26 recorded search pages: cars.com 44 Good Deal, 9 Great Deal, 10 High Demand and a dealer rating on most cards; Autotrader 22 Great Price, 13 Good Price, 12 Price Drop, 7 Online Paperwork; carvana 60 Price Drop, 22 Free shipping, 7 Great Deal (its 59 Recent tags are sort labels, not badges). Code: PR #51 added the card text per detail link (src/Odonomics/Walk/SearchPageLinks.cs, CardPrices.cs, KnownCardTouches.cs) and the walk\\u0027s known-card touch path; card text samples are in ~/Library/Application Support/Odonomics/walks/cars.com/20260926-121057/corolla-hybrid/search.txt lines 10 to 23 (price, mileage, title, then badges Great Deal and High Demand, dealer, rating 4.9, location) and the carvana and autotrader search texts under the same date; the PostingAttributes table and the upsert method come from c7313844; rank\\u0027s table is built in src/Odonomics/Cli/RankRenderer.cs (line 308 onward) inside an 80-column budget that PR #26 fought for, so the new column must be narrow.
